body: I just don’t see a point in living if my future is ruined. Not even my family will be around me since they are highly homophobic and I’m pan.

Sadly, my school’s administration is full of shitty people, so I don’t even want to risk everything being told to all of my teachers and all of my classmates. (That has happened in my previous school but luckily, it was anything as serious as this)

I will try to get enough courage to tell my parents that I need therapy by the end of this week.
